The '''Rescue on Myrkr''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] became briefly allied to defeat [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces on [[Myrkr]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] were successfully rescued but the smugglers became unwillingly engaged in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]].

==Prelude==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Myrkr]] was located between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] territory. During that time, [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Car'das/Legends|organization]] had its [[Myrkr Base|main base]] on Myrkr. In the early phases of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]], Imperial forces moved on the world in order to secure supplies of [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]].

==The Battle==
After being contacted by [[Joruus C'baoth]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] departed for [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]] aboard his [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[AA-589/Legends|''AA-589'']]. However, he was intercepted nearly twenty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] short of his destination by the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] and an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]].

He escaped but was captured by [[Talon Karrde]] and his [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] aboard the ''[[Wild Karrde]]''. He was sent to Karrde's base on Myrkr but eventually escaped the base in a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboat]]. He was pursued by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the [[Great Northern Forest]].

[[File:Stormtrooper_Myrkr.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] landing in the [[Great Northern Forest]].]]

Meanwhile, Imperial forces had arrived in Talon Karrde's base and discovered the presence of Skywalker on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

After the crash of their Skipray Blastboats, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was captured by Mara Jade. They latter tried to get out of the forest but both were attacked and captured by Thrawn's forces. They were conducted to [[Hyllyard City]] where they were rescued by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Karrde's smugglers.

==Aftermath==
By shooting on Imperial forces and helping the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], Karrde's smugglers had became enemies of the Empire. They were forced to evacuate Myrkr to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Consequently, Thrawn was free to settle on Myrkr to capture all the ysalamiri he needed.

In retaliation, Thrawn [[Raid on Myrkr Base|returned]] to Myrkr after the [[Battle of Sluis Van]], using [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to invade the planet. But as Thrawn had expected, Karrde had left no trace.
